# Vendored SDK

`macpoker-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl` is the unmodified MAC poker bot tournament SDK, downloaded from
https://poker.monashcoding.com/dl/macpoker-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl. Its package metadata declares `License: MIT`
(the wheel itself ships no LICENSE file or copyright line). It is kept here so a deployment build does not
depend on that download link staying up. Remove it and `pip install` the URL instead if you prefer.
